concurrent_process.interpretation: Implementation loop is running a 500K-token Needle-in-a-Haystack validation in native 3-bit KV mode. This directly addresses the Goal 1 gap (validate 1M context in practice — analyst BENCHMARKS.md currently only confirms 16K empirically). The --niah-500k flag is new. Native mode is the only viable backend for 500K-token KV cache on 48GB: at 500K tokens the 3-bit KV is ~20GB which still fits in Metal, whereas duo mode uses fp16 KV which would need ~107GB. A 500K NIAH run at native 3-bit is likely 30-60 minutes of GPU work.
